_doc: OPT-IN model-tier enforcement template (scout find #3, 2026-07-13). Copy the keys you want into .claude/settings.json to enforce them. NOT auto-applied by Forge — enabling it is an owner decision because it changes real harness behavior. See forge-core 'MODEL-TIER ENFORCEMENT (opt-in)' for the caveats.
_safe_option_availableModels: Constrains which Claude models any dispatch may use to the approved tier set. Non-breaking as long as EVERY model actually in use (including your current session model) is listed. enforceAvailableModels drops anything outside the list. Include the Fable id if you run sessions on Fable, or it may block your own session.
_opt_fallbackModel: scout #9 — single-turn 529/overload resilience on long Opus sessions (reverts next turn). NARROW scope: overload/unavailable/non-retryable server errors ONLY (NOT 429 rate-limit/billing/size). If you enable it, log any turn that completed on a fallback in FORGE_AGENT_LEDGER so a silent Opus→Sonnet/Haiku degradation on a quality-critical Boss is never hidden. For Security/Review/Head Chef prefer NO fallback (fail-and-retry).
_UNSAFE_do_not_blanket_deny: Do NOT add permissions.deny/ask ['Agent(model:opus)'] — review-boss/security-boss/boss are deliberately Opus, so a blanket Opus deny would BLOCK dispatching them, and in Forge's non-interactive background dispatch an 'ask' rule is converted to a hard DENY. Per-role model tiers are already pinned in each .claude/agents/<boss>.md frontmatter + agent-model-map.json; that is the correct place for 'Lead=Opus, most subagents=Sonnet/Haiku'.
_requires: Dispatch Bosses with model ALIASES (opus|sonnet|haiku|fable), not pinned IDs, so alias-to-ID resolution stays consistent; if any agent file pins a full model ID, normalize it to its alias before enabling strict matching. Update the IDs above when Anthropic ships new models (checked for v2.8.0: Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, Fable 5.1). NVIDIA offload is NOT governed here (it runs through nvidia-provider.cjs / usage-guard, never the Agent tool).
